# README

- **Author**: `蔡睿燊`
- **Created At**: `2026-10-18`
- **Last Modified At**: `2026-11-15`（改為 2024、2025 各輸出一檔；站點清單 120 站；格式比照 `youbike_station_hourly_flow_2024_2025.parquet`，不再合併天氣與日曆，也不再產生 `calendar_2024.csv`）

---

## What does this file do?

- 把研究範圍內各站的分鐘級狀態更新（站點剩餘數量資料），彙整成**站點 × 小時**的車數變化、騎乘淨流量與調度量，2024、2025 年各輸出一檔。
- **格式比照** [`youbike_station_hourly_flow_2024_2025.parquet`](../processed/youbike_station_hourly_flow/youbike_station_hourly_flow_2024_2025.parquet)（交易資料算出的每小時借還量；組員 2026-11-15 決定）：
  - 鍵值為 `station_id`（不含 `TPE` 的 `StationID`）× `datetime`，`datetime` 為**該小時的開始時間**，文字格式 `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`（Asia/Taipei），兩檔可直接以這兩欄合併。
  - 平衡格點：`stations_in_field.csv` 的全部 120 站 × 該年每個小時（2024 年 8,784 小時、2025 年 8,760 小時）。
  - `in_service`：該站在該小時已啟用 = 1。啟用日 = 站位快照 `first_seen` 與該站當年第一筆狀態更新日期中較早者（與交易版相同的規則）。2024 年檔中，2025 年才啟用的 `臺大人文館`、`羅斯福路三段283巷` 全年為 0。
  - **不合併天氣與日曆**。下游需要時，以 `datetime` 合併 `data/processed/weather/weather_taipei_hourly_2024_2025.parquet`，或以 `datetime` 的日期合併組員維護的 `data/processed/calendar_2024.csv`／`calendar_2025.csv`。注意天氣檔的 `datetime` 描述 (t − 1 小時, t]，本檔描述 [t, t + 1 小時)，合併前需對齊。
- **整點快照**（組員 2026-10-18 決定的取法，原在已移除的 `youbike_weather_hourly.Rmd`，現併入本檔）：每個整點 t 取該站 `SrcUpdateTime` ≤ t 的最後一筆狀態。以下情況不沿用舊狀態，快照設為 `NA`：
  - `no record yet`：該站在 t 之前當年還沒有任何紀錄。
  - `no-data day`：從最後一筆紀錄到 t 之間跨過整天無資料的日期（2024 年 10 天、2025 年 3 天）。
  - `stale > 24h`：最後一筆紀錄距 t 超過 24 小時。
- **每小時流量**：小時 [h, h + 1) 的流量由 h 與 h + 1 兩個整點快照決定，只有兩者都可用時才計算，否則流量欄位為 `NA`，原因記在 `flow_missing_reason`。
  - 每一筆更新相對於同站前一筆的可借車數變化稱為一個「步」（step）；更新時間落在 (h, h + 1] 的步歸入小時 h。這些步的加總等於兩個快照的差（下方有 assertion 核對）。
  - **調度判定**（組員 2026-10-18 決定，門檻由 AI 提議）：單一步的 |變化| ≥ 10 輛視為調度車補車或移車。2024 年單步 |變化| 的 99.9% 分位數為 9 輛，一般騎乘在兩分鐘內很難造成 10 輛以上的變化。
- 每年各自處理，不跨年取資料。因此每年第一個小時（1 月 1 日 00 時）沒有 00:00 的快照，流量為 `NA`；每年最後一個小時使用 12 月 31 日的資料取得 24:00 快照，可以計算。
- `ServiceStatus` 原樣保留（含「停止營運」），由下游分析決定是否排除。不補值、不做 train/test 切分。

## What does this file output?

- `data/processed/youbike_flow_hourly/youbike_flow_hourly_2024.parquet`、`data/processed/youbike_flow_hourly/youbike_flow_hourly_2025.parquet`
  - Output key: `flow_2024`、`flow_2025`
  - Description: 站點 × 小時 panel，19 欄：
    - `station_id`、`station_name`、`datetime`、`in_service`：定義同上。
    - `ServiceStatus_start`、`ServiceStatus_end`：h 與 h + 1 整點快照的營運狀態。
    - `AvailableRentBikes_start`、`AvailableRentBikes_end`、`AvailableReturnBikes_start`、`AvailableReturnBikes_end`：h 與 h + 1 整點快照的可借車數與可還空位（輛）。
    - `flow_missing_reason`：流量為 `NA` 的原因（取 h 快照的原因，沒有則取 h + 1 的）；流量可用時為 `NA`。
    - `net_flow`：`AvailableRentBikes_end` − `AvailableRentBikes_start`（輛；+ 為淨增加）。
    - `rider_return`、`rider_rent`：|變化| < 10 的增加步與減少步加總（輛，皆為非負）。兩分鐘內的借與還會互相抵銷，可能低估；可借車數在相鄰更新間 ±1 來回跳動時又會高估，**不可直接當作借還次數**，下游以 `rider_net_flow` 為主；實際借還次數請用交易版 `rent_total`／`return_total`。
    - `dispatch_in`、`dispatch_out`：|變化| ≥ 10 的增加步與減少步加總（輛，皆為非負）。
    - `rider_net_flow` = `rider_return` − `rider_rent` = `net_flow` −（`dispatch_in` − `dispatch_out`）。
    - `n_updates`：(h, h + 1] 內的更新筆數；`max_step`：該小時最大的單步 |變化|（輛），供下游改用其他門檻時參考。
  - Role: `analysis`
  - Documentation: 本檔（processed-data 文件待建立）
  - Expected schema and row-count rules: 19 欄；2024 年 120 × 8,784 = 1,054,080 列，2025 年 120 × 8,760 = 1,051,200 列；(`station_id`, `datetime`) 不重複；流量欄位只在兩個快照都可用時有值，此時步的加總 = `net_flow`、`rider_net_flow` + `dispatch_in` − `dispatch_out` = `net_flow`；`in_service` = 0 的列沒有流量。
  - Verification status / SHA-256: 見最後一個 chunk 的實際輸出與下方「執行結果」。
  - Downstream finding input: `finding/youbike_eda.Rmd`（尚未改用本版）

All paths are relative to the project root, not the operating-system root.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)

find_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  candidate <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(candidate, "AGENTS.md")) &&
        dir.exists(file.path(candidate, "templates"))) return(candidate)
    parent <- dirname(candidate)
    if (identical(parent, candidate)) stop("Open this notebook within the student project containing AGENTS.md and templates/.")
    candidate <- parent
  }
}
PROJECT_ROOT <- find_project_root()

project_file <- function(relative_path, area, must_exist = TRUE) {
  # Exact project-relative paths only; no first-file search or OS-root /data path.
  parts <- strsplit(relative_path, "/", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  if (grepl("^(/|~|[A-Za-z]:)", relative_path) || ".." %in% parts ||
      grepl("<", relative_path, fixed = TRUE) ||
      !startsWith(relative_path, paste0("data/", area, "/"))) {
    stop("Replace the placeholder with an exact path inside data/", area, "/: ", relative_path)
  }
  path <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, relative_path)
  if (must_exist && (!file.exists(path) || dir.exists(path))) stop("Input file not found: ", path)
  # Resolve existing ancestors to reject a path that leaves the project via a symlink.
  ancestor <- path
  while (!file.exists(ancestor)) ancestor <- dirname(ancestor)
  resolved <- normalizePath(ancestor, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  allowed <- normalizePath(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data", area), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  if (!startsWith(allowed, paste0(PROJECT_ROOT, "/"))) {
    stop("data/", area, "/ resolves outside the project root.")
  }
  if (!identical(resolved, allowed) && !startsWith(resolved, paste0(allowed, "/"))) {
    stop("Resolved path leaves data/", area, "/: ", relative_path)
  }
  path
}

sha256_file <- function(path) {
  if (!requireNamespace("digest", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Cannot verify input identity: digest is unavailable. Use an available SHA-256 implementation before loading data.")
  }
  digest::digest(file = path, algo = "sha256", serialize = FALSE)
}

verify_input_sha256 <- function(path, expected) {
  # Bind this run to the exact file inspected when the notebook was prepared.
  if (!is.character(expected) || length(expected) != 1L || is.na(expected) ||
      !grepl("^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$", expected)) {
    stop("Fill the expected SHA-256 from the inspected input before loading data.")
  }
  actual <- sha256_file(path)
  if (!identical(actual, tolower(expected))) stop("Input changed: identify the new version before loading ", basename(path), ".")
  actual
}
```

## 站點表

站點清單一列為站點 × 位置（移位過的站有兩列），這裡整理成一站一列。

```{r}
stations_in_field <- read_csv(
  input_paths[["stations_in_field"]],
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
)

station_table <- stations_in_field |>
  summarise(
    StationID = first(StationID),
    station_name = first(StationNameZh_tw),
    n_names = n_distinct(StationNameZh_tw),
    first_seen = min(as.Date(first_seen)),
    .by = StationUID
  ) |>
  arrange(StationID)

stopifnot(
  nrow(station_table) == 120L,
  all(station_table$n_names == 1L),
  all(station_table$StationID == str_remove(station_table$StationUID, "^TPE")),
  !anyNA(station_table$first_seen)
)

station_table |>
  filter(first_seen > as.Date("2024-01-02"))
```

## 每小時流量的計算函數

兩年使用同一套規則，因此寫成一個函數，分別套用到 2024 與 2025 年。函數回傳輸出資料與幾個供檢查的摘要表。

```{r}
DISPATCH_STEP <- 10L
MAX_STATUS_AGE_MIN <- 24 * 60
STATUS_COLUMNS <- c("ServiceStatus", "AvailableRentBikes", "AvailableReturnBikes")
FLOW_COLUMNS <- c("rider_return", "rider_rent", "dispatch_in", "dispatch_out", "n_updates", "max_step")
OUTPUT_COLUMNS <- c(
  "station_id", "station_name", "datetime", "in_service",
  "ServiceStatus_start", "ServiceStatus_end",
  "AvailableRentBikes_start", "AvailableRentBikes_end",
  "AvailableReturnBikes_start", "AvailableReturnBikes_end",
  "flow_missing_reason",
  "net_flow", "rider_net_flow", "rider_return", "rider_rent",
  "dispatch_in", "dispatch_out", "n_updates", "max_step"
)

# TRUE when the stretch from status_time to snapshot_time overlaps a no-data day.
# A no-data day d covers [d 00:00, d+1 00:00).
crosses_no_data_day <- function(status_time, snapshot_time, no_data_dates) {
  day_starts <- as.POSIXct(as.character(no_data_dates), tz = "Asia/Taipei")
  map2(day_starts, day_starts + days(1), \(day_start, day_end) {
    status_time < day_end & snapshot_time > day_start
  }) |>
    reduce(`|`, .init = rep(FALSE, length(status_time)))
}

build_flow_hourly <- function(rental_in_field, year) {
  year_start <- as.POSIXct(paste0(year, "-01-01 00:00:00"), tz = "Asia/Taipei")
  year_end <- as.POSIXct(paste0(as.integer(year) + 1L, "-01-01 00:00:00"), tz = "Asia/Taipei")
  hour_starts <- seq(year_start, year_end - hours(1), by = "hour")

  # 1. Whole days without any in-field record.
  all_dates <- seq(as.Date(paste0(year, "-01-01")), as.Date(paste0(year, "-12-31")), by = "day")
  no_data_dates <- all_dates[!all_dates %in% rental_in_field$source_date]

  # 2. On-the-hour snapshots at h = year start, ..., year end (one more than the hours).
  snapshot_grid <- expand_grid(
    StationUID = station_table$StationUID,
    snapshot_time = c(hour_starts, year_end)
  )
  status_updates <- rental_in_field |>
    select(StationUID, status_time = SrcUpdateTime, all_of(STATUS_COLUMNS))

  snapshots <- snapshot_grid |>
    left_join(status_updates, join_by(StationUID, closest(snapshot_time >= status_time))) |>
    mutate(
      status_age_min = as.numeric(snapshot_time - status_time, units = "mins"),
      missing_reason = case_when(
        is.na(status_time) ~ "no record yet",
        crosses_no_data_day(status_time, snapshot_time, no_data_dates) ~ "no-data day",
        status_age_min > MAX_STATUS_AGE_MIN ~ "stale > 24h",
        .default = NA_character_
      ),
      across(all_of(STATUS_COLUMNS), \(value) if_else(is.na(missing_reason), value, NA))
    ) |>
    select(StationUID, snapshot_time, all_of(STATUS_COLUMNS), missing_reason)
  stopifnot(nrow(snapshots) == nrow(snapshot_grid))

  snapshot_start <- snapshots |>
    filter(snapshot_time < year_end) |>
    rename(hour_start = snapshot_time) |>
    rename_with(\(name) paste0(name, "_start"), c(all_of(STATUS_COLUMNS), missing_reason))
  snapshot_end <- snapshots |>
    filter(snapshot_time > year_start) |>
    mutate(hour_start = snapshot_time - hours(1)) |>
    select(-snapshot_time) |>
    rename_with(\(name) paste0(name, "_end"), c(all_of(STATUS_COLUMNS), missing_reason))

  # 3. Steps: change in rentable bikes from the previous update of the same station.
  # A step whose update time falls in (h, h + 1] belongs to hour h.
  steps <- rental_in_field |>
    select(StationUID, SrcUpdateTime, AvailableRentBikes) |>
    arrange(StationUID, SrcUpdateTime) |>
    mutate(
      step = AvailableRentBikes - lag(AvailableRentBikes),
      gap_min = as.numeric(SrcUpdateTime - lag(SrcUpdateTime), units = "mins"),
      .by = StationUID
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(step)) |>
    mutate(hour_start = ceiling_date(SrcUpdateTime, "hour", change_on_boundary = FALSE) - hours(1))

  step_summary <- steps |>
    summarise(
      steps = n(),
      median_gap_min = median(gap_min),
      p999_abs_step = quantile(abs(step), 0.999),
      share_abs_step_ge_10 = mean(abs(step) >= DISPATCH_STEP),
      share_abs_step_ge_20 = mean(abs(step) >= 20)
    )

  hourly_steps <- steps |>
    summarise(
      n_updates = n(),
      step_sum = sum(step),
      rider_return = sum(step[step > 0 & step < DISPATCH_STEP]),
      rider_rent = -sum(step[step < 0 & step > -DISPATCH_STEP]),
      dispatch_in = sum(step[step >= DISPATCH_STEP]),
      dispatch_out = -sum(step[step <= -DISPATCH_STEP]),
      max_step = max(abs(step)),
      .by = c(StationUID, hour_start)
    )
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(select(hourly_steps, StationUID, hour_start)))

  # 4. In service from the earlier of first_seen and the first status update this year.
  first_update <- rental_in_field |>
    summarise(first_update_date = min(source_date), .by = StationUID)
  in_service_table <- station_table |>
    left_join(first_update, join_by(StationUID), relationship = "one-to-one") |>
    mutate(in_service_from = pmin(first_seen, first_update_date, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    select(StationUID, station_id = StationID, station_name, in_service_from)

  # 5. Station x hour grid with both snapshots and the steps in between.
  flow <- expand_grid(StationUID = station_table$StationUID, hour_start = hour_starts) |>
    left_join(snapshot_start, join_by(StationUID, hour_start), relationship = "one-to-one") |>
    left_join(snapshot_end, join_by(StationUID, hour_start), relationship = "one-to-one") |>
    left_join(hourly_steps, join_by(StationUID, hour_start), relationship = "one-to-one", unmatched = "drop") |>
    left_join(in_service_table, join_by(StationUID), relationship = "many-to-one") |>
    mutate(
      flow_missing_reason = coalesce(missing_reason_start, missing_reason_end),
      flow_available = is.na(flow_missing_reason),
      net_flow = AvailableRentBikes_end - AvailableRentBikes_start,
      # Hours with two valid snapshots but no update had no change.
      across(all_of(c(FLOW_COLUMNS, "step_sum")), \(value) if_else(flow_available, coalesce(value, 0L), NA)),
      rider_net_flow = rider_return - rider_rent,
      in_service = as.integer(as.Date(hour_start, tz = "Asia/Taipei") >= in_service_from)
    )

  stopifnot(
    nrow(flow) == nrow(station_table) * length(hour_starts),
    !anyDuplicated(select(flow, StationUID, hour_start)),
    # Steps inside (h, h + 1] add up to the difference between the two snapshots.
    with(flow, all(!flow_available | step_sum == net_flow)),
    with(flow, all(!flow_available | rider_net_flow + dispatch_in - dispatch_out == net_flow)),
    with(flow, all(flow_available | is.na(net_flow))),
    with(flow, all(in_service == 1L | !flow_available)),
    all(flow[FLOW_COLUMNS] >= 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  flow <- flow |>
    arrange(station_id, hour_start) |>
    mutate(datetime = format(hour_start, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "Asia/Taipei")) |>
    select(all_of(OUTPUT_COLUMNS))

  list(flow = flow, no_data_dates = no_data_dates, step_summary = step_summary)
}
```

## 計算 2024、2025 年

一次只讀入一年的狀態更新，以控制記憶體用量。

```{r}
results <- list()
for (year in YEARS) {
  rental_in_field <- read_parquet(input_paths[[paste0("rental_", year)]])
  stopifnot(
    nrow(rental_in_field) == EXPECTED_RENTAL_ROWS[[year]],
    !anyDuplicated(select(rental_in_field, StationUID, SrcUpdateTime)),
    identical(attr(rental_in_field$SrcUpdateTime, "tzone"), "Asia/Taipei"),
    all(rental_in_field$StationUID %in% station_table$StationUID),
    all(format(rental_in_field$source_date, "%Y") == year)
  )
  results[[year]] <- build_flow_hourly(rental_in_field, year)
  rm(rental_in_field)
  gc()
}
```

## 檢查結果

```{r}
for (year in YEARS) {
  flow <- results[[year]]$flow
  cat("\n=====", year, "=====\n")
  cat("No-data days:", format(results[[year]]$no_data_dates), "\n")
  print(results[[year]]$step_summary)

  glimpse(flow)
  print(colSums(is.na(flow)))

  # Why flow is missing; in_service = 0 rows are stations not yet opened.
  flow |>
    count(in_service, flow_missing_reason) |>
    print()

  # Stations not in service for the whole year, or opened during the year.
  flow |>
    summarise(
      in_service_hours = sum(in_service),
      flow_hours = sum(!is.na(net_flow)),
      .by = c(station_id, station_name)
    ) |>
    filter(in_service_hours < n_distinct(flow$datetime)) |>
    print()

  # Dispatch summary, normal service at both snapshots.
  flow_valid <- flow |>
    filter(ServiceStatus_start == "正常營運", ServiceStatus_end == "正常營運", !is.na(net_flow))

  flow_valid |>
    summarise(
      station_hours = n(),
      hours_with_dispatch = sum(dispatch_in + dispatch_out > 0),
      dispatch_bikes = sum(dispatch_in + dispatch_out),
      dispatch_share_of_abs_net = sum(dispatch_in + dispatch_out) / sum(abs(net_flow)),
      hours_abs_net_ge_25 = sum(abs(net_flow) >= 25),
      hours_abs_net_ge_25_with_dispatch = sum(abs(net_flow) >= 25 & dispatch_in + dispatch_out > 0),
      hours_abs_rider_net_ge_25 = sum(abs(rider_net_flow) >= 25)
    ) |>
    print()

  flow_valid |>
    summarise(
      hours_with_dispatch = sum(dispatch_in + dispatch_out > 0),
      dispatch_bikes = sum(dispatch_in + dispatch_out),
      .by = c(station_id, station_name)
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(dispatch_bikes)) |>
    head(5) |>
    print()
}
```

## 寫出與讀回驗證

```{r}
dir.create(dirname(output_paths[["flow_2024"]]), showWarnings = FALSE)

verification <- list()
for (year in YEARS) {
  key <- paste0("flow_", year)
  path <- output_paths[[key]]
  if (file.exists(path)) stop("Output already exists; review it before replacing: ", path)
  frame <- results[[year]]$flow
  write_parquet(frame, path, compression = "zstd")
  reread <- read_parquet(path)
  stopifnot(
    identical(names(reread), OUTPUT_COLUMNS),
    nrow(reread) == nrow(frame),
    isTRUE(all.equal(as.data.frame(frame), as.data.frame(reread), check.attributes = FALSE))
  )
  verification[[key]] <- list(
    data_path = OUTPUTS[[key]],
    rows = nrow(reread),
    columns = ncol(reread),
    size_mb = round(file.size(path) / 1e6, 2),
    sha256 = sha256_file(path),
    status = "read-back checks passed"
  )
  print(verification[[key]])
}

# Inputs must be unchanged after processing.
for (key in names(input_paths)) {
  stopifnot(identical(sha256_file(input_paths[[key]]), input_fingerprints[[key]]))
}
```

## 執行結果

2026-11-15 改寫後（站點清單 120 站；2024、2025 各一檔；格式比照交易版每小時流量；不合併天氣與日曆）以乾淨 R 程序（`Rscript --vanilla`，`knitr::knit()` 輸出至暫存位置）完整執行，取代 107 站、只有 2024 年、含天氣與日曆的版本（SHA-256 `98602b08…`，939,888 列 × 28 欄；組員已於 2026-11-08 移至 `data/temp/superseded_2026-11-08/`）。以下為實際輸出：

- 輸入核對：三個輸入檔的 SHA-256 皆與預期一致，執行後未改變；兩年的狀態更新筆數與上游一致。
- **與前版比較（2024）**：前版以時段結束 t 標記、本版以開始 t − 1 標記；對齊後原 107 站的 939,781 站時中，`net_flow`、`rider_return`、`rider_rent`、`dispatch_in`、`dispatch_out`、`n_updates`、`max_step`、`rider_net_flow` 的數值全部相同，前後快照的營運狀態與可借車數也相同。前版另有 107 列描述 2023-12-31 23 時，本版不含。
- 2024 年：1,054,080 列（120 站 × 8,784 小時）× 19 欄。
  - 步 11,035,872 個；相鄰更新間隔中位數 1.92 分鐘；單步 |變化| 99.9% 分位數 9 輛，≥ 10 輛的步占 0.072%。
  - 流量可用 947,074 站時；不可用 107,006 站時：未啟用（`in_service` = 0，含 2025 年才啟用的 2 站）68,064、已啟用但尚無紀錄 180、跨無資料日 31,429、超過 24 小時未更新 7,333。
  - 兩個快照皆「正常營運」的 938,878 站時中，6,584 站時含調度步，調度共 101,966 輛次，占 |淨流量| 的 3.4%。調度最多的站為捷運公館站 2 號出口（20,385 輛次）與 3 號出口（11,968 輛次），新增站中 `臺灣科技大學側門` 排第 3（5,015 輛次）。
- 2025 年：1,051,200 列（120 站 × 8,760 小時）× 19 欄。
  - 步 6,458,260 個；相鄰更新間隔中位數 2.22 分鐘；單步 |變化| 99.9% 分位數 **22 輛**，≥ 10 輛的步占 **0.84%**（2024 年為 0.072%）。
  - 流量可用 1,031,844 站時；不可用 19,356 站時：未啟用 7,584、已啟用但尚無紀錄 222、跨無資料日 9,482、超過 24 小時未更新 2,068。
  - 兩個快照皆「正常營運」的 1,031,647 站時中，46,217 站時含調度步，調度共 824,610 輛次，占 |淨流量| 的 **25.2%**。
- **2025 年 4 月起調度判定不可靠**：每站每小時平均更新筆數由 1–3 月的 8–11 筆降到 4 月起的 3–5 筆（12 月 2.7 筆），一個步涵蓋的時間變長，多筆騎乘累積起來就超過 10 輛。依相鄰更新間隔分組，間隔 ≤ 3 分鐘的步 ≥ 10 輛者只占 0.075%，6–12 分鐘占 1.3%，30 分鐘以上占 6.5%。調度占 |淨流量| 的比例在 2025 年 1–3 月為 0.8%–2.8%，與 2024 年相近，4–12 月升到 17%–46%。**因此 2025 年 4 月起的 `dispatch_in`／`dispatch_out`／`rider_return`／`rider_rent`／`rider_net_flow` 的拆分不可直接使用**；`net_flow`（兩個快照的差）不受影響。2024 年 10–11 月調度比例也偏高（11.1%、7.8%），可能與颱風與無資料日前後有關，尚未確認。
- 讀回檢查全部通過。
